Hydrated zinc sulfate gives off water when it is heated.
ZnSO4•xH2O(s)  →  ZnSO4(s)  +  xH2O(g)
A student does an experiment to determine the value of x in ZnSO4•xH2O.
step 1
The student weighs a sample of hydrated zinc sulfate.
step 2
The student heats the sample of hydrated zinc sulfate.
step 3
The student weighs the solid after heating.
step 4
The student repeats step 2 and step 3 until the mass of solid after heating is constant.
